name: Exploring Opportunities & Challenges Through Secondary Data

content.title: Exploring Opportunities & Challenges Through Secondary Data
content.summary: AKU-IED organises seminar with Dr Muhammad Akram, Australian Catholic University

media.alt: Exploring Opportunities & Challenges Through Secondary Data

content.text: In a stimulating session of the Kazim Bacchus Research Seminar series hosted by AKU-IED, attendees delved into the intricacies of analyzing secondary data, discovering both the opportunities and challenges inherent in this research approach. The event, which took place on Wednesday, January 24, 2024, featured Dr Muhammad Akram, a distinguished research fellow and bio-statistician from the Merry Mackillop Institute of Health Research (MMIHR) at the Australian Catholic University, Melbourne.

Dr Akram, who holds a PhD in Statistics from Monash University with a focus on time-series analysis and forecasting, brought a wealth of expertise to the seminar. He commenced the session by illuminating the essential nature of secondary data, emphasizing its role as a valuable complement to primary data in the research landscape. Drawing on his experience, Dr Akram discussed the biases and limitations inherent in working with secondary data, shedding light on key considerations for researchers navigating this terrain.

One of the session's highlights was Dr. Akram's insightful exploration of the challenges faced by students and young researchers as they embark on their research journeys. Attendees were provided with valuable guidance on overcoming these challenges, ensuring a more robust and nuanced approach to utilizing secondary data for research purposes. Dr. Akram's emphasis on mitigating potential pitfalls in the research process resonated with the diverse audience, comprised of faculty, students, and enthusiastic alumni from AKU-IED.

Beyond simply identifying challenges, Dr Akram actively engaged with educators, sharing practical insights on how to conduct effective secondary analysis. He delved into the tools and methodologies that can enhance the validity and reliability of research outcomes. The session proved to be a valuable resource for educators seeking to integrate secondary data analysis into their research methodologies, offering a roadmap to navigate complexities and extract meaningful insights.

The Kazim Bachhus Research Seminar series continues to be a beacon of intellectual exploration, offering a platform for thought leaders to share their insights and experiences. The latest session, exploring the nuanced world of secondary data analysis, not only enriched the academic community at AKU-IED but also resonated with a wider audience, fostering a collaborative spirit in the pursuit of knowledge and research excellence.
